evals.prompt: In my analog-attach project at /workspace/rpi4 (a Raspberry Pi 4), add an AD7124-8 ADC to the overlay. It is on SPI0, chip select 1; nothing else uses that chip select, so the spidev there can go. Its RDY/DOUT interrupt is wired to GPIO 25, falling edge. Channel 0 measures AIN0 against AIN1, differential. Make sure the overlay validates.
evals.expected_output: The project's overlay adds an AD7124-8 on SPI0 at chip select 1 with its interrupt on GPIO 25, falling edge, and channel 0 measuring AIN0/AIN1; the spidev on chip select 1 is disabled, SPI0 is enabled, and the overlay validates with no errors and no conflicts.
assertions: The overlay has an adi,ad7124-8 node under SPI0 with reg 1
The ADC's interrupt is GPIO 25 of the gpio controller, falling edge
Channel 0 has diff-channels 0 1
The spidev on chip select 1 is disabled and SPI0 is enabled
validate reports no errors
The overlay is not built (no .dtbo or .dtb in the project outside .analog-attach/): the request didn't ask for a build
